{{Otheruses|Docking Bay 27}}
'''Docking Bay 27''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the criminals [[Teeku]], [[Nawara Blen]] and [[Koobis (Clone Wars)|Koobis]] used a modified [[transponder]] to summon the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' to the bay, and the trio requested that the [[Heroes of Cularin|crew of the ''Starchaser'']] transport a crate of illicit goods to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Janvar Jan]].
